Specification number:   010.001  Dutch Unsalted Lactic Butter (82%)  Ongezouten zure boter (82%)  Mildgesäuerte markenbutter (82%)   Version Date:   01.09.2017  Beurre lactique non salé (82%)   Page:   3 of   3  Statement GMO  We, Royal VIV Buisman, herewith declare to the best of our knowledge and based on statements of our suppliers that our products do not contain any ingredients of GMO origin as mentioned in Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003. Therefore, our products do not need to be labelled in accordance with Regulation (EC) No 1830/2003.  Dutch Dairy Regulations  Supervision of compliance with legislation and regulations in Dutch dairy production: The Dutch government supervises the safety and quality - of products and production processes - throughout the entire supply chain. Supervisory guidelines are based on Dutch and European legislation and regulations. A number of official authorities carry out the inspections, including the Netherlands Controlling Authority of Milk and Milk Products (COKZ), the Inspection Service of Public Health and Veterinary Aspects and the Animal Feed Sector Quality Service and the National Inspection Service of Livestock and Meat.  Statement Contaminants and residues  We, Royal VIV Buisman, herewith declare that our products are in compliance with Commission Regulation (EC) No 1881/2006, Regulation (EC) No 396/2005 and Council Regulation (EEC) No 470/2009 and their amendments regarding contaminants, residues of pesticides and residues of veterinary medicinal products. These parameters are under supervision of the Netherlands Controlling Authority for Milk and Milk products (COKZ).  Statement Ionising radiation treatment / irradiation  We, Royal VIV Buisman, herewith declare that our products are not treated with ionising radiation/irradiation as mentioned in Directive 1999/2/EC and Directive 1999/3/EC.  To the best of our knowledge and based on statements of our suppliers, we herewith also declare that our products do not contain any ingredients, which are treated with ionising radiation/irradiation.  This statement does not take into account the packaging of the product.  EU legislations  Packaging   In accordance with Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004, Commission Regulation (EC) No 2023/2006, Commission Regulation (EU) No 10/2011 and its amendments.  Food hygiene   In accordance with Regulation (EC) No 852/2004, Regulation (EC) No 853/2004 and Regulation (EC) No 854/2004 and their amendments.  Food safety   In accordance with Regulation (EC) No 178/2002 and its amendments.  Radioactivity   In accordance with Council Regulation (Euratom) No 2016/52 and its amendments.  Other information  Antioxidants   Absent  Preservatives   Absent  This document replaces all previous editions and the information which it contains may be changed at any time without further notice.
